fao_areas(): FAO主要渔区

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/fao_areas.Rmd
fao_areas.Rmd

英文原页：fao_areas()

说明

该函数列出由渔业统计协调工作组（CWP）划定、用于统计的FAO主要渔区：19个海洋渔区和各大洲的内陆水域。每个渔区给出代码、名称、所属大洋、数据最后一年的渔获量，以及FAO官方地图的链接。plot = TRUE时，把标有渔区代码的海洋渔区世界地图保存为figures/png/area/fao_major_areas.png。

English

This function lists the FAO major fishing areas for statistical purposes, defined by the Coordinating Working Party on Fishery Statistics (CWP): the 19 marine areas and the inland waters of each continent. For each area it gives its code, name, ocean, catch in the last year of the data and the link to its official FAO map. With plot = TRUE, a world map of the marine areas labelled with their codes is saved as figures/png/area/fao_major_areas.png.

用法 

fao_areas(
  data = NULL,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = fao_setting("pptx")
)

参数

data
load_fao_data()返回的FAO渔获数据，用于计算最后一年的渔获量。默认为NULL，即最新版本（load_fao_data()）。
English FAO catch data as returned by load_fao_data(), used for the catch of the last year. Default is NULL, the latest release (load_fao_data()).
plot
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，世界地图保存在figures/png/area/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the world map is saved in figures/png/area/.
table
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the table is saved in tables/.
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the map text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
pptx
逻辑值。为TRUE时，地图还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/area/。默认为fao_settings()中的设置（未更改时为FALSE）。
English A logical value. If TRUE, the map is also saved as an editable PowerPoint file in figures/pptx/area/. Default is the value set with fao_settings() (FALSE unless changed).

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每个渔区一行：area_code、name_en、name（所选语言的名称）、type（“marine”海洋或”inland”内陆）、ocean（所属大洋）、catch_last_year（最后一年渔获量，吨）、share_pct（占当年全球渔获量的百分比，包括海洋和内陆）和fao_map（FAO官方地图的链接）。地图保存在属性”plot”中。

English

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per area: area_code, name_en, name (in the chosen language), type (“marine” or “inland”), ocean, catch_last_year (tonnes), share_pct (percentage of the world catch of the year, marine and inland) and fao_map (link to the official FAO map). The map is in the attribute “plot”.

详细说明

官方地图是FAO渔区地图页面（https://www.fao.org/fishery/docs/maps/Default.htm）上的GIF图片；本包只提供链接，不复制这些图片。世界地图根据本包自带的渔区边界（inst/extdata/FAO_AREAS_CWP.shp，FAO，CC BY 4.0）绘制，投影和中心经度按fao_settings()的设置。单个渔区及其分区的地图见fishing_area_map()。

English

The official maps are the GIF images of the FAO fishing area maps page (https://www.fao.org/fishery/docs/maps/Default.htm); the package links to them and does not copy them. The world map is drawn from the area boundaries bundled with the package (inst/extdata/FAO_AREAS_CWP.shp, FAO, CC BY 4.0), in the projection and central longitude set with fao_settings(). fishing_area_map() maps one area with its subareas.

参考文献

CWP (Coordinating Working Party on Fishery Statistics). CWP Handbook of Fishery Statistics: Main water areas (FAO major fishing areas). Rome: FAO. https://www.fao.org/cwp-on-fishery-statistics/handbook/general-concepts/main-water-areas/en/

FAO. Fishing area maps. In: FAO Fisheries and Aquaculture Division [online]. Rome. https://www.fao.org/fishery/docs/maps/Default.htm

FAO (2024). FAO Major Fishing Areas for Statistical Purposes. In: FAO Fisheries and Aquaculture Division [online]. Licence: CC-BY 4.0. https://www.fao.org/fishery/geonetwork?uuid=ac02a460-da52-11dc-9d70-0017f293bd28

另请参阅

fishing_area_map() for the map of one area and its subareas.

示例 

areas <- fao_areas(lang = "zh")
areas[areas$type == "marine", c("area_code", "name", "catch_last_year")]
